verdict.rationale: Pipedream explicitly offers a browser-based 'chat app' (chat.pipedream.com) built with Vercel's AI SDK to 'try out Pipedream MCP' before integrating into your own app, which functions as a hosted playground for exercising MCP tools. However, the evidence doesn't describe a dedicated tool-by-tool inspector (e.g., a UI to browse/list individual tool schemas and invoke them ad hoc) — it's framed as a chat interface rather than an explicit inspector/playground UI. Missing for 10: a documented tool-listing/inspector UI showing individual tool schemas and manual invocation, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of this chat app's tool-exercising capability.
